'''Gamma Squad''' was a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] military unit was guarding [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gorik]]'s base on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During [[Havoc Squad]]'s assault on the [[Kalarath Imperial Encampment]] as part of the [[Operation: Stoneduster]], [[Alpha Squad (Tatooine)|Alpha]], [[Beta]] and Gamma Squads escaped alongside Colonel Gorik, while [[Delta Squad (Tatooine)|Delta Squad]] stayed behind to cover their escape.<ref name="SWTOR" />
